title: Historical panel release report be89623934: panel-status
value:
Status: stage 1 (read-only, 1.20.0) and stage 2 (certificates, backups and
logs in the answers; plans, confirmed actions as jobs, 1.21.0) are
implemented in `admin/panel_gate.py`, `panel gate-enable|gate-disable|
gate-status`, test `panel_e2e`. Creating and deleting sites, databases and
owners are the next stages.

title: Historical panel release report be89623934: release-data
value:
- **Data a panel shows.** `site describe` and `self describe` now include the
  certificate nginx serves for each site: names, issuer, expiry, days left,
  auto-renewal. `site describe` lists the site's data backups (date, size,
  parts, checksums, encryption) and their daily schedule.
  `logs nginx --output json` returns the last lines as data.

title: Historical panel release report be89623934: release-jobs
value:
- **Actions with a plan.** Through the gateway an action first answers what
  it would do. With `confirm` it starts as a job: a transient systemd unit
  that outlives the panel, with status, a live log with a cursor,
  cancellation and a list of recent jobs. Owners act and see jobs only on
  their own sites.

title: Historical panel release report be89623934: release-verification
value:
- `panel_e2e` (59 checks) on Ubuntu 22.04, 24.04 and 26.04: certificate and
  backup data, log tails, plans that change nothing, a backup job with its
  log and cursor, owner scope for actions and jobs, cancelling a running job,
  plus all stage 1 checks. `static_e2e`, `backup_tests`, `host_e2e` and
  `adopt_e2e` on all three; `node_e2e` on 24.04 and 26.04 (22.04 ships
  Node.js 12, older than the test application needs).
